candidate_rule: within the frozen pilot-selected radius-angle support, retain each node's k nearest incident edges and take their undirected union
selection_rule: on DIAMOR-1, preserve the frozen fixed-rule covered-snapshot count and minimize mean candidate edges; break ties by smaller k
frontier_query: oracle-q mean within-dyad distance with base-protocol thresholds
claim_boundary: post-hoc mechanism audit using DIAMOR-1 selection and previously touched DIAMOR-2 follow-up; labels determine eligibility, exclusions, pilot coverage constraint, oracle q, and evaluation
